name: ntfy-agent
description: Notify your phone when Claude Code finishes a turn or needs your input.

urls.title: Destinations
urls.description: Where to send. ntfy://<topic> for ntfy.sh (a random topic acts as the password), or pover://user@token, tgram://token/chat, gotify://token@host, discord://id/token, slack://path, https://your-webhook. Comma separated for several. Leave blank to fall back to the config file.

desktop.title: Desktop banner
desktop.description: Also show a desktop banner: auto (skips SSH, CI and headless), always, or never.

min_seconds.title: Minimum turn length
min_seconds.description: Skip finished-turn notifications for turns shorter than this many seconds. Permission prompts always get through.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Mute finished-turn notifications during this local-time window, e.g. 23:00-07:00. Blank disables. A blocked agent still notifies.

body.title: Message body
body.description: summary sends the agent's last message. none sends only the title, keeping code and paths off a third-party server.
